providers.name: Arkade Wallet

regions.label: Availability varies

action.label: Copy invoice, then open Arkade Wallet

Wallet funds the covenant in Ark VTXOs; solver pays the invoice and claims with preimage. Wallet tracks refund/settlement separately.
